bounded_host_request.command: set -eu; q="SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM posting_deliveries d JOIN announcement_posts a ON a.announcement_id::text=d.source_id AND a.owner_user_id=d.owner_user_id JOIN public_post_drafts p ON p.owner_user_id=d.owner_user_id AND p.module='announcement' WHERE d.telegram_message_id=4639 AND d.status='sent' AND p.step='published' AND p.data->>'kind'='recruitment' AND p.data->>'screenMessageId' ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND p.data->>'text'=a.text) THEN 0 WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM posting_deliveries d JOIN public_post_drafts p ON p.owner_user_id=d.owner_user_id AND p.module='announcement' WHERE d.telegram_message_id=4639 AND p.step='published' AND p.data->>'screenMessageId' ~ '^[0-9]+$') THEN 81 ELSE 82 END"; n=$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -tAqc "$q" | tr -d '[:space:]'); case "$n" in 0|81|82) exit "$n";; *) exit 83;; esac
